translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Kabilia kwebumaboma deli mina Midiani
Guyau iluki Mosese kawala,
“Bukumipuki mina Midiani paila avaka bogwa leivagaisi baisa mina Isireli. Avai tuta bukuvagi makawala, oluviga yoku bukukwaliga.”
Mapaila Mosese iluki tomota kawala, “Kukwatubaiasasi paila kabilia, e bukubasisi kabilia deli mina Midiani, e bukumipukwaisi matausina paila avaka bogwa leivagaisi baisa Guyau.
Ibodi dala dilatala dilatala olopola Isireli biwitali tailakatuluwotala tokabilia.”
Mapaila inagaisi tailakatuluwotala tauwau metoya dala dilatala dilatala, e kasi bawa komwaidona iboda 12,000 matausina tobasi okawakali.
Mosese iwitali matausina ilosi ikabiliasi. Peniasi matauna Eleasa tolula latula ikugwai matausina, matauna tokaraiwogala guguwa kwebumaboma deli makwaisina taudoudou.
E makawala Guyau eikaraiwogi Mosese, matausina ivabodaisi valu Midiani, e ikatumataisi komwaidona tauwau,
deli goli Midiani si gweguya kasitailima yagasi Ebi, Rekem, Sura, Ura, deli Reba. Balam matauna Beori latula deli wala ikatumataisi.
E mina Isireli ikatupipaisi vilesi Midiani deli gugwadi, ivayoulisi si bulumakau deli yuwoulela si mauna, ikwayaisi komwaidona si veiguwa,
deli igabwaisi si valu deli si kabosikaiwa komwaidona.
Ivayoulisi komwaidona guguwala, tomotala, deli maunela,
e imiakaisi Mosese sola Eleasa deli goli komwaidona mina Isireli tosibwaiga eisisuaisi osi kabosikaiwa oitayatilela Mowabi katitaikinela Yoridani kibubotala biloula Yeriko.
Tokabilia ikaimilavausi
Mosese, Eleasa, deli goli komwaidosi tokugwala Isireli isunapulasi metoya osi kabosikaiwa, e ilosi ibodaisi tokabilia.
Mosese saina igibuluwi kasi tokaraiwaga deli si kumatoula mabudosina eikaimilavausi metoya okakabilia.
Mosese ikatupoi matausina kawala, “Avaka paila gala kukwatumataisi vivila?

Kululuwaisi minasinala vivila eikabikaulasi Balam la karaiwaga, makawala okwaitala eileiki mapilana Peori minasina ivakadaisi tomota bipakaisi Guyau. Baisa uulela kwaitala lelia mwau leiyomituli Guyau la tomota kasi mwau.
Mapaila baisa tuta kukwatumataisi komwaidona gugwadi tauwau deli vivila minasina bogwa eikikapugulasi.
Mitaga komwaidona vivila gugwadi deli kapugopugula minasina gala ikikapugulasi gala bukukwatumataisi, kuyosisi baisa mi vavagi.

E availa availa yokomi lokukwatumataisi kaina lokukwabikonaisi tomata uwosi, bukusiwaisi wala oyosewala kabosikaiwa biboda kwailima kwaiyu yam. E yam kwaitolula deli yam kwailima kwaiyuwela yokomi bukukwatumigileuwaimi deli goli vivila minasina lokukwatupipaisi.
Tuvaila ibodi bukukwatumigileuwaisi karekwa yatala yatala, deli avai vavagi eibubulokaisi metoya mauna kanuvinesi, gota unuunusi, kaina avai vavagi eiyoudulokaisi metoya kai.”
E Eleasa matauna tolula iluki tauwau matausina eikaimilavausi metoya okabilia kawala, “Karaiwaga makwaisina Guyau isaiki Mosese.

Komwaidona vavagi makwaisina gala ibodi kova bivakasosu, makawala goula, siliba, barasi, deli goli tanumnumta ituwoli ituwoli makwaisina bukukwatumigileuwaisi metoya wa kova. E avai guguwa makwaisina ituwoli bukukwatumigileuwaisi metoya sopila katumigileu.
E yam kwailima kwaiyuwela yokomi bukuwinaisi kami karekwa, e bogwa bukumigileusi mokwita e bibodi bukusuvisi okabosikaiwa.”
Guguwa ivilaisi
E Guyau iluki Mosese kawala,
“Yoku som Eleasa, deli goli matausina tokugwala Isireli, bukukwalauwaisi guguwa komwaidona lokumaiyaisi metoya okabilia, kukwalumgolaisi tokatupipi deli mauna komwaidona.
Kuvilaisi guguwa makwaisina bila wala guloyu, gulotala paila kabilia, e guloyuwela paila tomota komwaidona.

E metoya okasi vilavila tokabilia bukukwau taitala wala metoya lakatulima matausina tokatupipi, natana bulumakau metoya lakatulima e makawala goli bukuvigakaisi baisa minasina ase, sipi, deli gota. Baisa bukuvigakaisi mi pokala baisa Guyau.
Bukusakaisi matausina deli minasina baisa Eleasa tolula baisa bivigaki Guyau kala katukila.

E metoya okasi vilavila tomota komwaidona bukukwau taitala wala metoya tailuwolima matausina tokatupipi, natana bulumakau metoya buluwolima bulumakau e makawala goli bukuvigakaisi baisa minasina ase, sipi deli gota. Bukusakaisi matausina deli minasina baisa mina Libai matausina iuwotetilasi Guyau ola Buliyoyova.”
E Mosese sola Eleasa ivagaisi avaka Guyau eikaraiwogi matausina.

Baisa makawala kala takasa avaka tokabilia leimaiyaisi metoya okabilia deli goli makwaisina leivatulumasi paila titoulesi, kala bawa baisa makawala. 675, 000 sipi deli gota, 72,000 bulumakau, 61,000 ase, 32,000 vivila kapugopugula.

E sipi deli gota ivilaisi isakaisi tokabilia 337, 500 kasi vilavila, e metoya minasina ikauwaisi 675 ivigakaisi si pokala baisa Guyau; 36,000 bulumakau, e metoya minasina ikauwaisi naluwolima naluwoyu nayu ivigakaisi si pokala baisa Guyau, 30,500 ase e metoya minasina ikauwaisi naluwolima naluwotala natana ivigakaisi si pokala baisa Guyau; e 16,000 kapugopugula, metoya minasina ikauwaisi naluwotolu nayu ivigakaisi si pokala baisa Guyau.
Mapaila Mosese isaiki Eleasa pokala baisa ivigaki Guyau kala katukila, makawala avaka Guyau eikaraiwogi Mosese bivagi.
E tomota kasi vilavila bogwa makawala tokabilia kasi vilavila. 337, 500 sipi deli gota, 36,000 bulumakau, 30,500 ase, e 16,000 kapugopugula.

Metoya vilavila makwaina Mosese ikau taitala metoya tailuwolima tokatupipi, deli natana metoya naluwolima bulutuvalu, e makawala goli Guyau eikaraiwogi isaiki mina Libai matausina kala towotetila Guyau la Buliyoyova.
Oluvi kumatoula matausina eikugwaiyaisi tokabilia ilokaiasi Mosese
ilukwaisi kawasi, “Tomoya ka, bogwa lakakalawaisi avaka kasi bawa tokabilia e gala taitala isasa matala.

Mapaila avaka taitala taitala lakakauwaisi metoya okabilia bogwa bakamiakaimsi guguwa makwaisina eibubulokaisi goula, mlipwapwa, mituwetuwa, kakalougwa, paya deli kuwekuwa. E makwaisina ma semakaiyaisi baisa Guyau paila eikoli ma momovasi, kidamwa matauna bivigaki kada tokwalasi.”
E Mosese sola Eleasa ikauwaisi komwaidona guguwala katubaiasa goulawokuva wala.
E guguwa makwaisina avaka tokabilia kasi tokugwa eikauwaisi kala mokaila pikekita wala bibudoki luwovasi petala kaula (200 kg).
E availa availa matausina gala tokugwa mitaga tokabilia wala, iyosasi wala si guguwa avaka leikauwaisi.
Mapaila Mosese sola Eleasa ikauwaisi guguwa makwaisina goulawokuva ilauwaisi Guyau ola Buliyoyova; kidamwa Guyau bikoli mina Isireli.
